notes.title: Greenbacks and Greybacks. Union and Confederate dollars.
notes.content: Earn Union and Confederate dollars by shooting enemies and staying alive. As the Battle of the Wilderness was fought in 1864, then Confederate currency is valued a lot lower than Union greenbacks.

notes.title: Active reload.
notes.content:
A reload minigame to speed up the reload process. Gears style!

[h1]Update 1.0.9:[/h1]
[h2][i]Additions:[/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Active reload - During reload press again R for 2x faster reloads (indicator has to be in the dark sector for a perfect active reload).
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix for union weapons.
notes.content: Fixed alive union soldiers missing rifles.

notes.title: Line battle improvements.
notes.content: Changes to line battle logic as originally intended.

notes.title: Improvements to melee combat.
notes.content: Ability to enter melee combat quickly while aiming.

notes.title: Skirmish mode fixed.
notes.content: Fixed half of union forces not moving into positions in Skirmish mode. This unfortunate bug was present since the Conquest mode update.

notes.title: Performance update.
notes.content: Rush through enemy lines with better framerates.

notes.title: Nightmare mode.
notes.content:
New difficulty settings. 
[h1]
Update 1.0.7:[/h1]
[h2][i]Additions:[/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]4 new difficulty modes - Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare.
[*]Better cannon interactions and a new cannon user interface.
[/list]

notes.title: 2 new Conquest maps.
notes.content:
New conquest maps "Orange Turnpike" and "Longstreet's attacks". 
[h1]
Update 1.0.6:[/h1]
[h2][i]Additions:[/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]2 new Conquest mode maps with 1000 tickets.
[*]The new map "Orange Turnpike" has less foliage for best possible performance.
[*]First-person is now the default viewpoint.
[*]Performance improvements to line battles.
[*]A dedicated restart button to quickly jump back into the action.
[/list]

notes.title: First-person mode
notes.content:
Experience the wilderness battlefield in first-person or third-person viewpoint. 
Press "space" to toggle between first person and third person mode.

notes.title: Conquest mode. New map.
notes.content:
Capture and hold vital positions in the wilderness. 
[h1]
Update 1.0.4:[/h1]
[h2][i]Additions:[/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Conquest mode. Domination with 1000 tickets.
[*]Capture the flags and crush the enemy forces in the forest.
[*]New map with wider flanking options. Feel the pressure!
[/list]
 
Happy 4th of July!

notes.title: Performance update.
notes.content: Added two new settings for controlling the amount of fallen soldiers on screen.

notes.title: Ragdolls, Hardee hats, Butternut uniforms.
notes.content:
The wilderness battlefield is covered with fallen corpses.
[h1]
Update 1.0.3:[/h1]
[h2][i]Additions:[/i][/h2]
[list]
[*] Confederate and Union uniform variations:
[list]
[i]Hardee hats
Butternut uniforms
Sky blue trousers 
Knapsacks, 
Blanket rolls
Slouch hats.[/i]
[/list]
[*] Ragdoll death animations.
[*] Fallen corpses on the battlefield.
[/list]

Thank you Cpl. J. C. Pedersen 3rd ID for the uniform suggestions.

Thank you everyone who has bought the game!

notes.title: Split screen co-op & controller support.
notes.content:
Stand in line with your friends or family and face the devastation that is Civil War era line warfare!

[h2]Update 1.0.2:[/h2]
[h3][i]Additions:[/i][/h3]
Split screen local co-op for two players!
Controller support for single player and couch co-op.
Play co-op on the same keyboard or with two controllers.

notes.title: Badass Civil War Beards. Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
The first update is all about beards. Authentic facial hair inspired by Burnside, Jenkins & Grant - face enemy volleys in style!

[h2]Update 1.0.1:[/h2]
[h3][i]Additions:[/i][/h3]
15 new beard styles. Muttonchops, goatees, long beards.
Skirmish game mode with 500 tickets. Quick battles.

[h3][i]Changes:[/i][/h3]
Thicker smoke to cloud the battlefield.
Reduced damage to bayonet attacks.

[h3][i]Fixes:[/i][/h3]
Fixed infantry death animations freezing.
Player reloading animations exiting correctly while walking.
Union lines sometimes not moving after attacks.
